name: claudeticker
description: A row under the prompt that shows what each turn spent: a live cost meter, a bar chart of turns or a cost-share strip, with tokens, cache hits and cost colored against the session

style.title: Style
style.description: meter: a bar of blocks that fills while the turn runs, on a fixed dollar scale (full at $2). chart: one small bar per recent turn, its height the cost on a fixed dollar scale. strip: the recent turns side by side (setting Strip turns), each block as wide as its share of them.

stripLabels.title: Strip labels
stripLabels.description: on: each block of the strip style shows its turn name and share (FIX 13%) where it fits. off: plain colored blocks.

stripTurns.title: Strip turns
stripTurns.description: How many recent turns the strip style shows, the running one included. More turns make narrower blocks: names show only where they fit, and with many blocks a thin line replaces the blank cell between them.

reacts.title: Reacts during the turn
reacts.description: on: the row moves on every step of a turn; each tool call flashes its name and bumps the bar, and the live marker pulses.

stock.title: Stock-market flavour
stock.description: on: costs and the token counts roll like an odometer; the Σ and cost digits that change flash, green going up, red going down.

celebrate.title: Celebrations and alerts
celebrate.description: on: a cheap, well-cached turn sparkles green and a new session high pulses red.

shimmer.title: Shimmer while tokens flow
shimmer.description: on: while Claude streams a response, the current turn shimmers: the filled part of the meter, the live block of the strip, the live bar of the chart.

grow.title: Animate changes
grow.description: on: the meter bar, the chart bars and the strip blocks ease to their new size and color in about 0.4 s instead of jumping.

newHighToast.title: New-high toast
newHighToast.description: on: a toast when a turn costs more than every earlier turn of the session (from the fourth turn on).

label.title: Entry label
label.description: What names each turn in the row. symbol: a short word from the prompt (FIX). prompt: the turn number and the first words of the prompt (#7 fix the login). number: the turn number alone (#7). numbered: number and symbol, the turn number then the short word (#7 FIX). While a background helper is still working on a finished turn, the row can show that turn: ↻ before its name, and its number when it is not the newest (↻ #71 FIX).

change.title: Change vs previous turn
change.description: How each turn compares with the one before in the row. dollars: the difference in dollars (up 0.31). percent: the difference in percent (up 282%). off: hidden.

tokens.title: Token figures
tokens.description: compact: 312K and 2.1K with down and up arrows (input and output tokens; the teal digits at the start of the input number are the share read from the prompt cache). labeled: 312K in · 2.1K out, the same teal digits on the input number.

cachePercent.title: Show cache %
cachePercent.description: on: the share of the input read from the prompt cache also shows as a number in teal right after the input figure (312K↓ (94%c) 2.1K↑, or 312K in (94% cached) · 2.1K out when labeled). It drops with the token counts on a narrow window, and shows nothing before the turn has usage. off: only the teal digits.

gapAbove.title: Blank line above the row
gapAbove.description: on: one blank line between the row and the lines above it. off: the row sits right under them.
